svg.title: VIA Metro Late Night System Map

text.tspan: North Star / North Blanco / Stone Oak
These routes are scheduled to depart from Kel-Lac Transit Center at 11:03pm,
just after Route 276 [COMMERCE / KLAC TRANSIT CTR. Lineup] is scheduled to arrive.
All lineup routes, including those that serve Express daytime routes,
are classified as regular bus service. VIA’s regular bus fare is
required to ride lineup service. Customers can also use a valid
transfer slip or a monthly, daily, 7-day or Semester bus pass.

**This is an unofficial map created by Junimeek, who is not affiliated with VIA Metropolitan
Transit. When VIA announces service changes that affect the late night system, an updated map
Every night at 10:30 p.m., 11:30 p.m. and 12:30 a.m., buses from many routes line
up together within a few blocks of each other in the downtown area. Once all the
buses have arrived and riders have made their transfers, the buses depart.
These outgoing buses travel along a fixed route, turn around, and then return to the
11:30 p.m. lineup, or, in the case of the 12:30 a.m. lineup buses, the VIA garage.
Because these buses need to serve as many riders as possible while still returning
downtown or to the VIA garage by 11:30 p.m. or 12:30 a.m., routing is modified or
